Runtime Systems

Gameplay

Gameplay is built from reusable Constructs assembled from Fragments and configured with Components and services.

Constructs

Runtime gameplay entities assembled from Fragment hierarchies and given identity via Components.

Recipes

Definitions that combine Fragments into complete units (fighters, buildings, etc.).

Components & Behaviors

Resource, Team, Targeting, Weapon, Lane Push, Auto Combat, movement, spawn, respawn, and particle components drive live behavior from authored Fragment definitions.

Homing Projectiles

Weapons can opt into bounded target-seeking projectiles without changing legacy straight-flight behavior. Homing Enabled is Off by default, and Homing Turn Rate limits how quickly a projectile can rotate toward the target captured at fire time.

Normal shots remain Range-limited. Homing shots do not use Range as a post-launch expiry, but still have a hidden safety timeout. When a target is lost, the projectile travels unguided briefly and then cleans up. Countermeasures and interception volumes are not part of the ordinary Hit Box contract.

AI Economy

Commanders, purchase strategies, and deployment systems enable dynamic AI opponents in match modes.

Key Pattern

FragmentAsset → Construct Recipe → Runtime Actor with Components → Gameplay Systems.
